text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, Trainer! Did you know this!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I heard a shop opened near the station 
that lets you customize your very own pro 
wrestling mask, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Animal-shaped ones, horror-themed, 
cute ones, all sorts of things!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El has the mask Papa gave me, so I don't 
need one, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And with that, let's get going!

Swept along by the momentum without room 
for argument, I was dragged off toward the 
station...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, what kind of mask do you 
want!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I guess as El's partner, it's gotta be a 
condor mask, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Or maybe El is the Champion of the Sky, 
and Trainer-san is the Champion of the 
Earth!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this is quite a dilemma!
choice_data_list: Like a cheetah with quick acceleration?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A cheetah! That's an opponent I'd love to 
race someday, yeeeess! Safely, of course!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! I think they're worthy of 
being the partner of the strongest, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will give you a mask as a present! Make 
sure to wear it whenever El is racing, 
okay!
—And then.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nwoooooh! So coooool, YES! Just looking at 
it makes me want to run!!

Seeing the completed cheetah mask, El 
Condor Pasa got super excited and wore a 
look of utter satisfaction.

I gratefully accepted the gift of the 
mask, but politely declined wearing it in 
the cheering section...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"An elephant...! Giant! Mighty! Truly the 
strongest! Even El is no match for it in 
sheer power!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When you look at it that way, it might be 
just perfect for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're the one supporting El, so 
you've gotta be strong!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will give you a mask as a present! Make 
sure to wear it whenever El is racing, 
okay!
—And then.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trumpet! You look so strong, YEEES! You're 
overflowing with power!

Seeing the completed elephant mask, El 
Condor Pasa got super excited and wore a 
look of utter satisfaction.

I gratefully accepted the gift of the 
mask, but politely declined wearing it in 
the cheering section...
